title: AI hiring, hybrid work, autonomy and professional trust
discussion_signal: The post frames skills-based hiring, flexible work, autonomy and trust as linked hiring conditions for AI talent. It also presents candidate-reported concerns about AI screening and rigid attendance policies, making professional trust and human judgment part of the employment signal rather than only a productivity issue.
linked_research_question: When AI changes hiring and work organization, do flexibility, autonomy and human judgment become conditions of professional trust?
limits: Single public LinkedIn post and author-reported figures
Claims are not independently validated here
Professional audience and platform selection limit representativeness
